purpose: Teach: 夢想/貪欲/空虚/アクシデント/を通じまして/うねり/交わり/地平線

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、哲学者の夢想と現実の関係の論文を扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you wrote a paper on the relationship between philosophers' ideals and reality, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm but measured. Genuine curiosity in the question. Open posture — inviting him to expand. Not testing, genuinely interested in what he chose.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、貪欲な学術姿勢の研究者の伝記を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I focused on a researcher's biography, looking at their hunger for academic pursuit.
lines.style: Clear, measured response. Slight hesitation before the key phrase — finding the right frame. Steady eye contact. Not rehearsed, but careful with his words.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、戦後社会の空虚感の研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: That's insightful. You also explored post-war society and the feeling of emptiness it left behind?
lines.style: Gentle affirmation before the next question. Slight tilt forward — tracking his thinking. Warm, not pushing. The pace of someone who genuinely wants to understand.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、工場のアクシデント事例の分析を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I analyzed a factory accident case to understand how that emptiness manifested in real events.
lines.style: Calm, methodical. Grounding the abstract in the concrete. No defensiveness — this is simply what he did. Quiet confidence in the choice.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、ご支援を通じまして得た知見を、紙面でも報告致しました
lines.en: And through your mentorship, you were able to document those insights in a formal paper as well?
lines.style: Acknowledging his growth without overdoing it. Warmth underneath professional tone. Slight lean-in — showing she's genuinely pleased he did the work.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、波のうねりが沿岸生態に与える影響を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I examined how wave movement affects coastal ecosystems, pulling from what I learned through that process.
lines.style: Slightly more relaxed now. The work speaks for itself. A hint of quieter pride in the final phrase — connecting it back to the mentorship without saying so directly.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、東西文明の交わりの歴史を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: You've covered a lot of ground — even looking at how Eastern and Western civilizations have intersected through history?
lines.style: Genuine admiration in the tone. Slightly wider frame — acknowledging the breadth. Warm but not effusive. The respect of one thinker for another's range.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、地平線まで広がる平原の地理研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I studied the geography of vast plains stretching to the horizon, exploring that scope from another angle.
lines.style: The final response carries a quiet sense of completion. Even pacing, grounded. Slight softening at the end — he's done good work and he knows it, without needing to say it.
